name: @eigenpal/ooxml-core
description: Format-neutral OOXML package layer shared by the EigenPal editors: bounded ZIP and OPC names, the bounded XML reader, string sinks, resource limits, SHA-256, image headers, UAX #29 text units, the DrawingML color transforms, and the DrawingML geometry evaluator. Internal: `@pptx-editor.dev/core` inlines it at build time.
